name: M3_PPS200MI_SearchLine
description: Searches for purchase order lines (PO lines) given many different search criteria.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse that will receive the goods on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number for the line.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Sequential line number on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Subline suffix that distinguishes splits of the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Order type controlling how the purchase order is processed.

inputParameters.name: POTC
inputParameters.description: Category assigned to the purchase order, such as normal, consignment, or subcontract.

inputParameters.name: PUST
inputParameters.description: Highest line status currently present on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PUSL
inputParameters.description: Lowest line status currently present on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: SUNO
inputParameters.description: Supplier number associated with the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number ordered on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: PRCS
inputParameters.description: Service process used for subcontract or repair-related purchase order lines.

inputParameters.name: PITD
inputParameters.description: Item name as printed on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: SORN
inputParameters.description: Supplier’s own order number referenced on the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PUPR
inputParameters.description: Purchase price for the item on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CPPR
inputParameters.description: Confirmed purchase price per unit on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: PUUN
inputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase order quantity is expressed.

inputParameters.name: PUCD
inputParameters.description: Purchase price quantity used as the basis for the price on the line.

inputParameters.name: CPUC
inputParameters.description: Confirmed purchase price quantity associated with the confirmed price.

inputParameters.name: LNAM
inputParameters.description: Total line amount in the order currency excluding charges.

inputParameters.name: DWDT
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery date for the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CODT
inputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date agreed with the supplier for the line.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the line in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: CFQA
inputParameters.description: Confirmed quantity for the purchase order line in the purchase unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: ADQA
inputParameters.description: Confirmed quantity for the line in an alternate unit of measure reported at shipping confirmation.

inputParameters.name: TNQA
inputParameters.description: Transport notified quantity reported from the via address for the line.

inputParameters.name: RVQA
inputParameters.description: Received quantity reported for the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CAQA
inputParameters.description: Approved quantity for the line in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: RJQA
inputParameters.description: Quantity rejected during quality inspection for the line.

inputParameters.name: SDQA
inputParameters.description: Quantity stored in stock for the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: IVQA
inputParameters.description: Total quantity invoiced for the line in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Category indicating the origin type of the reference order number.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the purchase order line, such as a customer or manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Reference order line number linked to the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: OURR
inputParameters.description: Our reference number, also called agreement or contract

inputParameters.name: BUYE
inputParameters.description: Buyer responsible for the purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the purchase order line affects material planning.

inputParameters.name: HDPR
inputParameters.description: Main product code that groups the item into a product family.

inputParameters.name: CFMB
inputParameters.description: Conversion factor Main U/M to Basic U/M

inputParameters.name: CFPB
inputParameters.description: Conversion factor purch price U/M to BuM

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method used for shipping the goods.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the goods passes from supplier to buyer.

inputParameters.name: COLO
inputParameters.description: Color option of the item on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: SIZE
inputParameters.description: Size option of the item on the purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CHCS
inputParameters.description: Characteristics code describing the configured features of the item.
